newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH CEN. BANK SELLS PLN 633 MLN OF NBP-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH CEN. BANK SELLS PLN 633 MLN OF NBP-BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 600 million zlotys, the amount on offer of its 182-day NBP-bills and 33 million zlotys of 273-day bills against the central bank's 300 million zloty offer, the central bank said.
The bank sold the 182-day paper at an average rate of 22.00 percent, up from 21.99 percent at the last auction on January 3, 1997.
The bank sold the 273-day bills at an average rate of 21.01 percent, up from 19.97 percent at the last auction on November 7, 1996.
